assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire, structure, and heritage constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All construction and control conclusions remain conceptual until verified.

assumptions.statement: The submitted overall boundary is a rough repository proxy with official_boundary=false.
assumptions.impact: Areas and all dependent geometry must be recalculated when the official polygon arrives.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons approximate location and do not reproduce official detailed-design boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Textual announced areas govern task interpretation; exact local design requires replacement polygons.

assumptions.statement: Existing-building inventory, title, structural condition, and retain-renovate-demolish evidence are absent.
assumptions.impact: Submitted pavilion footprints are reversible design prototypes, not existing buildings or demolition decisions.

assumptions.statement: Traffic counts, station demand, road redlines, parking, and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The evidence spine is a conceptual pedestrian connection, not transport engineering.

assumptions.statement: Exact heritage objects, protection zones, and permissible interventions are not supplied.
assumptions.impact: Railway motifs remain graphic and reversible; physical works need heritage review.

assumptions.statement: Public hearing and time-bounded authorization are urban-design governance prototypes, not established statutory procedures.
assumptions.impact: Competent authorities must determine lawful scope and relationship to existing remedies.

assumptions.statement: Operators, budgets, procurement routes, service levels, and record-retention rules are not assigned.
assumptions.impact: Every project requires owner, funding, site, data, and safety confirmation before launch.

assumptions.statement: Personas and affected-group needs are design hypotheses derived from the brief, not completed fieldwork or personal profiling.
assumptions.impact: Co-design and accessible interviews are required before detailed service design.

assumptions.statement: All text-bearing figures are code-generated without third-party logos; public sources are linked rather than reproduced.
assumptions.impact: Any later photograph, map, logo, or participant record requires a separate rights check.
